rewrites.comment: Single-page app: React Router owns the URL, so any path that is not a real file must serve index.html. Without this, opening or refreshing /lessons returns a 404. /api is excluded explicitly rather than relying on Vercel resolving functions before rewrites — if that assumption were wrong, every AI call would receive the HTML page instead of JSON.

headers.comment: Vite fingerprints these filenames, so a new build produces new names and a stale cache can never be served.
